statement: Fifth Third Bancorp's EVE sensitivity is negative in both a +200 bps rising-rate scenario and a -200 bps falling-rate scenario at September 30, 2024.

The changes in EVE sensitivity from September 30, 2023 were primarily due to changes in forward interest rate expectations and shortening of the investment portfolio duration in both rising and falling rate scenarios.
Lam Research Corporation repurchased 828 thousand shares under its stock repurchase program during the quarter ended March 31, 2024, at an average price of $774.77 per share.

The share repurchases during the quarter ended March 31, 2024, were subject to a 1% excise tax under the Inflation Reduction Act, which reduced the available balance under the repurchase program and was included in the cost of shares repurchased.

Walmart Inc. operates in the highly competitive omni-channel retail industry, facing competition from various retail chains, eCommerce businesses, and companies offering digital advertising, fulfillment, and delivery services.
Walmart Inc. and its Walmart International segment are subject to potential impacts from currency exchange rate fluctuations on net sales and operating income.
Labcorp Holdings Inc.'s Dx operating income increased by $31.8 in the three months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
The increase in Dx adjusted operating income was driven by organic demand, acquisitions, and LaunchPad savings, partially offset by higher personnel costs.
PTC Inc.'s PLM software revenue growth for the first nine months of FY'24 (excluding Q1'24 ServiceMax revenue) would have been 6% year-over-year, with 5% constant currency growth.
PTC Inc.'s PLM ARR grew 12% (13% constant currency) from Q3’23 to Q3'24.
PTC Inc.'s CAD software revenue decreased in Q3'24 compared to Q3'23, primarily due to lower revenue in the Americas.
PTC Inc.'s CAD ARR grew 8% (10% constant currency) from Q3’23 to Q3'24.

Paycom Software, Inc. declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.375 per share of common stock on July 29, 2024, payable on September 9, 2024, to stockholders of record at the close of business on August 26, 2024.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. returned approximately $898 million of capital to shareholders in 2024, including $654 million in dividends and $244 million in share repurchases.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. repurchased the $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of the Silver Lake Convertible Debt for $1.59 billion in cash in 2024.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. increased its quarterly dividend by 11% to $1.09 per share in November 2024.
Motorola Solutions, Inc. added four acquisitions within its video and command center technologies in 2024.
CME Group Inc. declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.25 per share on February 6, 2025, payable on March 26, 2025, to shareholders of record on March 7, 2025.
The first quarter dividend payment under the declared program will total approximately $455.0 million, assuming no changes in the number of shares outstanding.
Lockheed Martin’s Aeronautics business segment sales increased $212 million, or 3%, in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
The Aeronautics sales increase was primarily driven by a $215 million increase in sales from the F-35 program due to higher volume on production contracts.
Aeronautics’ operating profit increased $41 million, or 6%, in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
The operating profit increase was attributable to a $20 million increase in profit booking rate adjustments and a $20 million increase from higher volume.
The $20 million profit booking rate adjustment increase was primarily due to an $80 million adjustment from favorable performance at completion on a classified program.
Lennox International Inc.'s Building Climate Solutions segment net sales decreased 6% in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the same period in 2024.

The Building Climate Solutions segment's revenue decline was primarily due to a 9% decrease in sales volumes caused by expected destocking and delays in customer orders related to the transition to the new R-454B product.

Biogen Inc.'s share-based compensation expense included in net income attributable to Biogen Inc. was $81.0 million for the Three Months Ended March 31, 2025, compared to $68.1 million for the same period in 2024.
Nucor Corporation's gross margins in the steel products segment decreased in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the first quarter of 2024 due primarily to lower average selling prices.
The largest decreases in gross margins within the steel products segment occurred at the joist and deck, metal buildings, and tubular products businesses.
Nucor's gross margins in the raw materials segment increased in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the first quarter of 2024, primarily due to increased profitability of DRI operations.
Marketing, administrative and other expenses decreased by $93.0 million in the first quarter of 2025 compared to the first quarter of 2024.
Equity in earnings of unconsolidated affiliates was $4 million in the first quarter of 2025 and $9 million in the first quarter of 2024.
Nucor recorded $29 million of losses and impairments of assets in the first quarter of 2025, with no such losses in the first quarter of 2024.
Applied Materials, Inc.'s Semiconductor Systems net revenue increased in fiscal 2024 compared to the prior year.
Semiconductor Systems net revenue growth was driven by customer investments in new capacity and new technology transitions.
Vulcan Materials Company's Aggregates gross profit per ton improved 19% in FY2025 Q1.
Vulcan Materials Company's cash gross profit per ton improved 20% in FY2025 Q1.
Vulcan Materials Company returned $104.1 million to shareholders in FY2025 Q1 through $38.1 million of common stock repurchases and $66.0 million of dividends.
Vulcan Materials Company's total debt to trailing-twelve months Adjusted EBITDA ratio was 2.3 times in FY2025 Q1.
M&T Bank Corporation's consumer loan net charge-offs increased in 2024 compared to 2023 across major portfolio types, excluding home equity lines and loans.
Sysco Corporation's free cash flow is calculated as net cash provided from operating activities minus purchases of plant and equipment, plus proceeds from sales of plant and equipment.
Sysco management views free cash flow as a non-GAAP liquidity measure that provides insights into cash available for strategic uses such as dividends, share repurchases, and acquisitions.
Starbucks Corporation's effective tax rate for fiscal 2024 was 24.3%, compared to 23.6% for fiscal 2023.

The increase in Starbucks' effective tax rate was primarily due to lapping valuation allowances from deferred tax assets (approximately 80 basis points) and accrual of foreign withholding taxes (approximately 60 basis points).
A tax benefit of approximately 60 basis points in Starbucks' fiscal 2024 was realized from electing an alternative tax approach in a foreign jurisdiction during the second quarter.
NextEra Energy, Inc.'s Energy Resources segment originated approximately 3.2 gigawatts of new renewables and battery storage projects in FY2025 Q1.
Insulet Corporation launched Omnipod 5 in Canada and Switzerland, contributing to a total of 13 international market launches.
Gilead Sciences' HIV product sales increased 6% to $18.2 billion in FY2023 compared to 2022.
The increase in HIV product sales was primarily due to higher demand across treatment and prevention, higher average realized price, and favorable channel inventory dynamics.
Biktarvy sales increased primarily reflecting higher demand, including patients switching from other Gilead HIV products, as well as higher average realized price.
Descovy sales increased primarily driven by favorable channel inventory dynamics and higher demand.
Walmart Inc.'s total revenues increased $8.8 billion or 5.7% for the three months ended July 31, 2023, compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year.

The revenue increase for the three months ended July 31, 2023 was primarily driven by strong positive comparable sales in the Walmart U.S. segment, including growth in average ticket from grocery and health and wellness sales, elevated inflation impacts in certain merchandise categories, and growth in transactions.
Net sales for Walmart Inc. were positively impacted by $0.6 billion of currency exchange rate fluctuations for the three months ended July 31, 2023.
Realty Income Corporation's net debt to annualized pro forma adjusted EBITDA was 5.4 times at the end of FY2024.
Fifth Third Bancorp's noninterest expense increased $56 million for the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
The increase in noninterest expense was driven by a $61 million rise in compensation and benefits for the three months ended September 30, 2024.
Mohawk Industries, Inc. recognized stock-based compensation expense related to restricted stock units (RSUs) of $7.0 million ($5.2 million net of taxes) for the three months ended September 28, 2024.
The Company granted 5,048 restricted stock units (RSUs) at a weighted average grant-date fair value of $150.84 per unit for the three months ended September 28, 2024.

Nasdaq, Inc.'s corporate solutions business serves both public and private companies and organizations through products such as Investor Relations Intelligence, Sustainability Solutions, and Governance Solutions.
Tapestry, Inc.'s sales in Japan grew 2% and in Other Asia rose 15% for the period covered by the filing, with growth observed in each country in the region, notably Korea and Malaysia.
Verisk Analytics, Inc.'s underwriting revenue increased $33.6 million or 6.8% in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.

The underwriting revenue growth was primarily due to annual price increases from model and content enhancements in forms, rules, and loss cost services, along with expanded solutions in extreme event solutions and new customer acquisitions.
The Procter & Gamble Company recognized a non-cash, after-tax impairment charge of $1.0 billion to adjust the carrying value of the Gillette intangible asset in FY2024.
Domino's Pizza, Inc.'s supply chain gross margin increased $38.2 million, or 13.7%, in FY2024 compared to FY2023.
The increase in supply chain gross margin as a percentage of revenues was 0.9 percentage points in FY2024.
The AES Corporation's operating margin for the three months ended September 30, 2024 decreased $43 million compared to the same period in 2023.
The decrease in operating margin was primarily driven by record-breaking drought conditions in Colombia and a partial outage at the Chivor plant due to a flooding incident in July 2024.

The adverse effects on operating margin were partially offset by higher margins from better hydrology in Panama, new businesses in the portfolio, higher contracted energy sales, and unrealized derivative gains.
Paychex, Inc.'s operating margin was 41.5% for FY2025 Q1 compared to 41.7% in the prior year period.
Paychex, Inc.'s other income, net decreased 19% to $10.4 million for FY2025 Q1 primarily due to lower average investment balances on corporate investments.
WEC Energy Group, Inc. increased its quarterly dividend to $0.8925 per share effective with the first quarter of 2025 dividend payment, representing a 6.9% increase.
The dividend increase aligns with WEC Energy Group, Inc.'s policy of targeting a dividend payout ratio of 65-70% of earnings.
Northrop Grumman Corporation's third quarter 2024 net earnings increased $89 million, or 9 percent, compared to the prior year period.

The increase in third quarter 2024 net earnings was primarily driven by higher operating income and a non-operating FAS pension benefit, partially offset by a prior year gain from a minority investment sale.
PulteGroup, Inc.'s Financial Services operations include mortgage banking, title, and insurance agency operations conducted through Pulte Mortgage LLC and other subsidiaries.
PulteGroup, Inc. originates mortgage loans using its own funds and funds from a credit agreement with third parties, selling most loans in the secondary market within 30 days of origination.
PulteGroup, Inc. sells servicing rights for originated loans through fixed price servicing sales contracts to mitigate risks and costs.

Globe Life Inc.'s life segment mortality assumptions were decreased across most channels in line with recent experience consistent with decreasing levels of excess deaths during the third quarter of FY2024.
Globe Life Inc.'s life segment lapse rate assumptions were slightly increased across all channels during the third quarter of FY2024.
The assumption review process for Globe Life Inc.'s life and health segments resulted in a $46.3 million net remeasurement gain for the third quarter of FY2024.
The life segment remeasurement gain of $71 million for the third quarter of FY2024 included $57 million related to assumption changes.
News Corporation's operating expenses decreased $13 million, or 1%, for the three months ended December 31, 2023, compared to the corresponding period of fiscal 2023.

The decrease in operating expenses for the three months ended December 31, 2023 was primarily driven by lower expenses at the Book Publishing segment due to lower manufacturing, freight, and distribution costs, and at the News Media segment due to lower production costs at News UK.
The decrease in operating expenses was partially offset by higher expenses at the Subscription Video Services segment due to higher sports programming rights costs.
Foreign currency fluctuations increased operating expenses by $8 million for the three months ended December 31, 2023.
Essex Property Trust, Inc. excludes historical cost depreciation and gains or losses from the sale of previously depreciated properties in its calculation of FFO, following the NAREIT definition.

Essex Property Trust, Inc. also excludes real estate depreciation, impairment write-downs from operating real estate, and losses from unconsolidated co-investments driven by a measurable decrease in the fair value of real estate held by the co-investment when calculating FFO.
NIKE, Inc. Revenues for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 were $12.43 billion compared to $12.39 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2023.
NIKE Direct revenues were $5.4 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2024 compared to $5.3 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2023, representing approximately 45% of total NIKE Brand revenues.
Quanta Services, Inc. acquired Cupertino Electric, Inc. (Cupertino) in July 2024 for approximately $1.5 billion in consideration, excluding cash acquired and subject to customary adjustments.
The acquisition of Cupertino Electric, Inc. included an estimated potential earnout payment of up to $200.0 million.
Fidelity National Information Services, Inc.'s Banking segment revenue increased 2% for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to 2023.
Recurring revenue contributed 3% to the Banking segment's total revenue growth rate in 2024, driven by higher transaction processing revenue.
A decline in non-recurring revenue offset the Banking segment's revenue growth rate by (1%) in 2024, driven by the completion of federally funded pandemic relief programs.
APA Corp reported net income attributable to common stock of $673 million in the first six months of 2024, compared to $623 million in the first six months of 2023.

The increase in net income for APA Corp in the first six months of 2024 was primarily driven by higher revenues from the Callon acquisition, increased drilling activity in the Permian Basin, and higher realized oil and NGL prices.
APA Corp generated $1.2 billion of cash from operating activities during the first six months of 2024.
Yum! Brands, Inc. defines same-store sales growth as the estimated percentage change in system sales of all restaurants open for one year or more, including temporarily closed locations.
Same-store sales growth excludes the extra day from leap years for monthly calendar subsidiaries and the last week of the year for weekly periodic calendar subsidiaries.
Yum! Brands, Inc. considers same-store sales growth a key performance metric to assess brand strength and operational effectiveness.
Occidental's long-term debt was rated Baa3 by Moody's Investors Service, BBB- by Fitch Ratings, and BB+ by Standard and Poor's as of March 31, 2025.
A downgrade in Occidental's credit ratings could impact its ability to access capital markets and increase its cost of capital.
Occidental or its subsidiaries may be required to provide collateral in various forms, including cash or surety bonds, under certain contractual arrangements.

Abbott Laboratories' Diabetes Care segment sales increased 21.6% in the first three months of 2025, excluding foreign exchange effects, with CGM systems sales totaling $1.7 billion compared to $1.5 billion in the same period of 2024.

Abbott Laboratories' Rhythm Management segment sales increased 6.1% in the first three months of 2025, excluding foreign exchange effects, primarily due to growth in Aveir® leadless pacemakers, partially offset by a decrease in traditional pacemaker and implantable cardioverter-defibrillator sales.
Solventum Corporation's Dental Solutions segment net sales decreased 2.1% in the three months ended March 31, 2025, compared to the same period in 2024.
The decline in Dental Solutions net sales was partially due to lost sales from certain health care businesses retained by 3M India in connection with the Spin-Off.
Foreign currency translation negatively impacted Dental Solutions net sales by (1.9%) in the three months ended March 31, 2025.
Phillips 66 repaid $59 million in principal on its 3.605% Senior Notes due February 2025 upon maturity on February 18, 2025.
Phillips 66 acquired EPIC Y-Grade GP, LLC and EPIC Y-Grade, LP, including their subsidiaries, for $2.2 billion in cash on April 1, 2025.

Zebra Technologies Corporation plans to drive growth through expansion in adjacent market segments, both organically and inorganically, focusing on segments synergistic with core markets where offerings, workflow expertise, and customer relationships enable significant value.

Zebra Technologies Corporation intends to enhance financial strength and flexibility by improving profitability and cash flow generation through operational execution, supply chain resiliency, cost management, and working capital efficiency, while maintaining a strong balance sheet.

Zebra Technologies Corporation emphasizes a sustainable business model aligned with sustainability priorities including human capital management, resource conservation, and climate, supported by a cross-functional Sustainability Council with executive and board oversight.
REGENERON PHARMACEUTICALS, INC.'s EYLEA HD net product sales in the U.S. increased for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same periods in 2023.
The increase in EYLEA HD net product sales was driven by patient transition from other anti-VEGF products, including EYLEA, and new patients naïve to anti-VEGF therapy.
EYLEA net product sales in the U.S. decreased for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same periods in 2023.
The decrease in EYLEA net product sales was primarily due to patient transition to EYLEA HD and other market dynamics affecting volumes and net selling price.
Labcorp Holdings Inc.'s Dx segment operating income increased $9.6 million in the three months ended March 31, 2025, compared to the same period in 2024.
The Dx segment operating margin decreased 60 basis points year-over-year in the three months ended March 31, 2025.
J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc. had a $287 million outstanding balance on the revolving line of credit under its senior credit facility at June 30, 2024.
The company's revolving line of credit allows for a total commitment increase of up to $300 million and two one-year extensions of the maturity date.

Zoetis Inc.'s companion animal operational revenue grew 13% in FY2024 Q2, driven by key dermatology products, mAb products for OA pain (Librela and Solensia), vaccine products, and small animal parasiticides.
Zoetis Inc.'s livestock operational revenue grew 11% in FY2024 Q2 due to increased sales of cattle, poultry, and fish products, partially offset by declines in sheep products.
Zoetis Inc.'s US revenue grew 12% in FY2024 Q2, with companion animal and livestock segments contributing 13% and 11% growth respectively.
CarMax, Inc.'s wholesale vehicle revenues decreased 16.9% in fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.
The average selling price for wholesale vehicles decreased by approximately $1,200 in fiscal 2024.
The decrease in average selling price for wholesale vehicles in fiscal 2024 was primarily due to shifts in the mix of sales by vehicle age and decreased acquisition costs from market depreciation.
3M Company's Transportation and Electronics segments' sales decreased 1.4 percent in U.S. dollars for FY2024 compared to the prior period.
Adjusting for special item PFAS manufactured products (non-GAAP measure), 3M Company's Transportation and Electronics segments' sales increased 3.1 percent in U.S. dollars for FY2024.

3M Company's business segment operating income margins increased year-on-year for FY2024, driven by non-PFAS manufacturing growth and productivity, partially offset by dis-synergies from the Solventum spin-off.
PACCAR INC's heavy-duty truck retail market share in the U.S. and Canada increased from 27.7% in the first six months of 2023 to 31.5% in the first six months of 2024.
PACCAR INC's medium-duty truck market share in the U.S. and Canada increased from 12.8% in the first six months of 2023 to 17.3% in the first six months of 2024.
PACCAR INC's over 16-tonne truck market share in Europe decreased from 16.1% in the first six months of 2023 to 13.7% in the first six months of 2024.
